fieldNotes.truckGate: Long private access drive (1 Hostess Way) runs ~250 m from the rural public road to the plant. Street View at the road entrance (2024-02) shows only a Hostess monument sign - no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint. No checkpoint structure on the drive in z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the road entrance or anywhere on the access drive.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The ~250 m access drive plus large internal aprons easily hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard on the E side; ~15-25 drop trailers in marked rows.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~22 doors across the S building face and E dock bank; overhead estimate, satellite imagery may slightly predate full Hostess retrofit.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Separate dock clusters - S face apron and E-face dock bank.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Long approach drive and wide aprons leave abundant room for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main 330,000 sq ft production building plus one ancillary utility structure in the NE yard.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural site but only ~3 km from Arkadelphia; cellular coverage likely adequate - flagged as low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / rural setting, building surrounded by fields and woods.

citations.claim: Smucker FY2024 cited the new Arkadelphia AR bakery (dedicated to Hostess Donettes) as a key accomplishment; fully operational under Smucker.
Hostess 330,000-sq-ft Arkadelphia AR Donettes bakery ($120-140M); operating since Nov 2023 with 150+ workers.

verification.rationale: New Hostess Donettes bakery in Arkadelphia, fully operational under Smucker since late 2023; no closure signals.
